notes: Synthetic: authored by hand from the Cohere v2 Chat API reference (cohere-openapi.yaml: /v2/chat, ChatResponseV2, AssistantMessageResponse, ChatThinkingContent, Citation, ChatToolSource, Usage, ChatFinishReason, StreamedChatResponseV2 and every stream event schema, x-fern-streaming terminator [DONE]) and the docs pages v2/docs/streaming, v2/docs/tool-use-streaming, v2/docs/tool-use-citations, v2/docs/tool-use-overview, docs/reasoning and docs/models, read 2026-10-28 from github.com/cohere-ai/cohere-developer-experience (the source of docs.cohere.com, which was not reachable from the authoring session). Field names, event types and finish reasons are the documented ones; ids, token counts and text are invented. Replace each case with a recorded capture (source: recorded) when the live recorder runs. Usage carries cached_tokens (in the Usage schema, absent from the reference examples). message-start's delta.message carries the empty content/tool_plan/tool_calls/citations the streaming docs print. The tool_output of a citation source for a plain-string tool message is assumed to be the parsed JSON object, by analogy with the documented document-content case. SSE frames are event: + data: lines, ended by data: [DONE]. Error cases (case.json) from the errors page (fern/pages/cohere-api/errors.mdx, docs.cohere.com/reference/errors) and the reference's components/responses, read 2026-10-28: 400, 401, 402, 404, 422, 429, 498, 499, 500, a 503 before a stream, and a stream that fails mid-generation (message-end delta.error, finish_reason ERROR); only error_bad_request (temperature above 1) and error_not_found (upstream_patch.json asks for a model that does not exist) are recordable. list_models drives ListModels (its body is rooted models:$).

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap K3: citations (cited span, text and the tool output or document it came from) are dropped; the canonical message has annotations, but the adapter emits none, so a client cannot show sources for a grounded answer
known gap K5: the tool plan (the model's stated reasoning before its tool calls) is dropped instead of becoming content or reasoning_content; Cohere expects it back as tool_plan on the next turn
known gap K2: cached prompt tokens are dropped instead of reported as prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, so cache hits are invisible to cost accounting
known gap K11: the error id is dropped (parseCohereError reads only message), so a failed request cannot be traced with Cohere support
known gap K7: the error message of a stream that failed mid-generation is dropped, and the stream ends as a success (see stream_error's sanity gap)

known gap K1: message-end carries finish_reason under delta, and the parser reads a top-level finish_reason that is never sent, so every stream ends with "stop" (unmapped_finish_reason with an empty value); a tool-call stream says "stop" instead of "tool_calls", and MAX_TOKENS truncation is invisible

known gap K1: message-end carries usage under delta, and the parser reads a top-level usage that is never sent, so no stream reports usage (see streamSanityGaps in contract_test.go); billing and budgets see zero tokens for every Cohere stream

allowed_unknown_shapes.reason: known gap K3: streamed citations are dropped (see $.message.citations)
known gap K5: the streamed tool plan is dropped (see $.message.tool_plan)
known gap K1: the parser reads message-end's finish_reason from the wrong place (see message-end:$.delta.finish_reason), finds none, and falls back to "stop"
known gap K6: finish_reason TIMEOUT falls back to "stop", so a generation the API cut off for time looks complete; "length" is the nearest canonical reason
